name: Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the December 11, 2023 Regular Meeting of the
City Council and the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency Artesia has
been adjourned to 7:00 p.m. on December 18, 2023, in the City Hall Council
Chambers located at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia, California 90701.

Dated: December 11, 2023
___________________________________
/s/ Jennifer Alderete, Acting City Clerk
